title: Selume account
entrySubtitle: Optional account services; local journals need no login
localTitle: Your journal can always stay local
localDescription: Keep writing, viewing attachments, backing up and using existing sync options without registering or signing in. Account services are optional.
unavailableTitle: Account services are not available yet
unavailableDescription: Official account services are not enabled in this version. Your local journal and existing features remain available.
cloudTitle: Official cloud sync is not available yet
cloudDescription: Signing in only connects your account. It does not upload, move or delete journals or attachments on this device.
stagingEnvironment: Test environment · Not a production service
developmentEnvironment: Development environment · For integration testing only
passwordHint: 12–128 characters; spaces and case are preserved
verifyHint: Open the verification email, paste its token and enter the password you originally registered with.
resetHint: Paste the token from your recovery email and set a new password. Other devices will also need to sign in again.
mailAccepted: Request accepted. If the email is eligible, instructions will arrive by email. Check your inbox and spam folder, and wait one minute before resending.
verified: Email verified. You can now sign in.
passwordReset: Password reset. Sign in with your new password.
logoutDescription: Your local journals, attachments, backups and existing sync settings will be kept. You can continue using the app offline.
loggedOut: Signed out. Your local data has been kept.
logoutRemoteError: Signed out on this device. Local data has been kept, but revocation of the server session could not be confirmed.
tokenRequired: Paste the token from your email
invalidCredentials: The email or password is incorrect. Check them and try again.
unverifiedError: Verify your email before signing in.
invalidToken: This token has expired or has already been used. Request a new email.
registrationClosed: New registrations are currently closed. Existing accounts can still sign in.
deviceLimit: Your account has reached its device limit. Sign out on another device first.
rateLimited: Too many requests. Please try again later.
sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again. Local journals and attachments are unaffected.
networkError: Cannot connect to account services. Check your connection and try again. Local features are still available.
storageError: Could not securely read or save account credentials. Please try again.
invalidInput: Some information does not meet the requirements. Check it and try again.
serviceError: Account services could not complete this request. Please try again later.
